summaryForMax:
Line of sight to your outcome: this workstream serves the exploration-immersion (ENRICHED) layer — the predecessor made real stars carry real names everywhere; this one is meant to make real systems carry their real insides (star types, known planets, companions, structures) and make the known universe findable. Increment 2 of the 5-increment plan just landed.

What's solid: AC7 (build-time ingestion of exoplanet archive + dim hosts + companion table) and AC10 (engine can now represent white-dwarf companions, far companions, and overlay context) both PASS with full adversarial agreement — 1276/1276 tests green, zero regressions, and Alpha Centauri now works end-to-end as a hand-authored proof (AC5's static/structural checks all look right too, just not yet driven live).

Two ACs are confirmed FAIL, but expected at this stage, not alarming: AC4 (generalized procgen-fill for arbitrary real stars) and AC6 (structures/globular-cluster audit report) are both provably absent from the repo — but the contract itself schedules AC4 for Increment 3 and AC6 for Increment 5, neither of which has started. Five ACs are stuck at INSUFFICIENT because they require driving the actual running app, which no static review can substitute for, and nothing has driven them yet: AC1 (neighborhood fidelity), AC2 (player search — feature doesn't exist until Increment 4), AC3 (real characteristics for non-registered stars like Sirius), AC5 (the three-arrival-path live check for Alpha Centauri), and AC8 (the Sol regression guardrail's actual enterSol()/runIntegrationSuite() live check — this one is now overdue across two increments because the dev server was reportedly down both times).
